## Company overview

Freedom Holding Corp. is a financial conglomerate in the Financial Services sector, with a market capitalization of $10.75B. Through its subsidiaries it provides securities brokerage, securities dealing, market making, investment research, investment counseling, retail and commercial banking, and insurance products. It reports through four segments: Brokerage, Banking, Insurance, and Other. The Brokerage segment covers investment banking, including M&A, underwriting and capital markets advisory, as well as margin lending and debt capital markets solutions.

## Financial commentary

Revenue grew from $795.69M in fiscal 2023 to $1.64B in fiscal 2024, then to $1.99B in fiscal 2025 and $2.17B in fiscal 2026. The most recent revenue growth rate is given as 27.8%. Net income has been far less steady: $205.14M in fiscal 2023, $379.11M in fiscal 2024, a drop to $76.29M in fiscal 2025, and a partial recovery to $153.33M in fiscal 2026.

The net margin is 8.4% and return on equity is 10.7%. Debt/Equity stands at 1.82. The dividend yield is 0.0%, so the company currently returns no income to shareholders through dividends. Growth in sales has therefore not translated into smooth profit growth, which is worth keeping in mind when reading the valuation multiples.

## Comps commentary

The comparison uses P/B as the primary multiple, against a peer group of Interactive Brokers, Charles Schwab, Robinhood, Virtu Financial and Kaspi.kz. Freedom Holding trades at a P/B of 6.7 against a peer median of 3.8, a premium of 77%. On earnings, its trailing P/E of 66.9 compares with a peer median of 17.6 (+280%), and its forward P/E of 37.5 compares with 12.2 (+207%).

Profitability and income metrics point the other way. Its ROE of 10.7% is 56% below the peer median of 24.0%, and its dividend yield of 0.0% compares with a peer median of 1.3%. Revenue growth of 27.8% is 6% above the peer median of 26.3%, so the premium valuation rests on growth that is only slightly ahead of peers, while returns on equity are well behind. One caution is that Kaspi.kz shows a forward P/E and P/B of 0.0, which look like missing data and may distort the peer medians.
